glosses: Pertaining to the field of medicine; medical.
That practises medicine; pertaining to doctors, physicianly.

examples.text: Her father was thrown from his horse, when his blood was in a very inflammatory state, and the bruises were very dangerous; his recovery was not expected by the physical tribe.

glosses: Medicinal; good for the health, curative, therapeutic.

examples.text: Phisicall [translating φαρμακώδεις (pharmakṓdeis)] herbes, as Helleborum, Lingewort, or Beares foote.

glosses: Pertaining to the world as understood through the senses rather than the mind; tangible, concrete; real. Having to do with the material world.

examples.text: Labour, then, in the physical world, is […] employed in putting objects in motion.

glosses: In accordance with the laws of nature; now specifically, pertaining to physics.

examples.text: The substance has a number of interesting physical properties.

glosses: Denoting a map showing natural features of the landscape (compare political).

examples.text: Are you feeling any physical effects?

glosses: Involving bodily force or contact; vigorous, aggressive.

examples.text: This team plays a very physical game, so watch out.

glosses: A physical manifestation of psychic origin, as through ectoplasmic solidification.

examples.text: "I don't mind readings and clairvoyance, but the physicals do try you."
